description: Elena has one unused driveway space and must decide whether to make a short-term parking arrangement with a nearby visitor, settling the price, access hours, payment, parking method, and Saturday availability after hearing from the prospective parker, a neighbor, her housemate, and a friend who measured the space.

shared_context.S1: Elena has one driveway space available for a temporary parking arrangement from Tuesday through Saturday.
shared_context.S2: Inez, Gareth, Maya, and Jon are present while Elena considers the arrangement.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the final call on whether to accept an arrangement and sets its exact terms.
shared_context.S4: Elena's usual practice before lending the driveway is a round-robin check: each person present states one practical detail they know, and Elena waits until all four people have spoken before deciding.
shared_context.S5: When Elena states the terms aloud, her usual practice is to identify the person who supplied each practical term so everyone can verify the arrangement.

PF1.text: Inez's complete proposal is to pay exactly $125 in advance for use by her blue hatchback from Tuesday through Friday, 06:00-18:00.

PF2.text: Gareth has another interested parker who would pay exactly $150, but that person needs the space overnight from Friday through Sunday and would pay after the weekend.

PF3.text: Maya sets up a farmers-market stall every Saturday and needs the driveway completely clear from 07:00 through 10:00 on Saturday.

PF4.text: Jon measured the space and confirmed that Inez's blue hatchback fits only when parked nose-in with at least 0.50 m of clearance from the side gate.

acceptance_conditions: The arrangement must accept Inez as the parker.
Access must be Tuesday through Friday from 06:00 through 18:00.
Payment must be made in advance.
The competing offer must be recorded as exactly $150 for overnight Friday-through-Sunday use with payment after the weekend.
The driveway must be required to remain clear on Saturday from 07:00 through 10:00.
The parking method must be nose-in with exactly 0.50 metres of side-gate clearance.
Jon's measurement must be cited as justification for the parking method and clearance.

content_checks.C5: decisions['comparison_offer_amount'] == 150 and decisions['comparison_offer_days'] == 'Friday-Sunday overnight' and decisions['comparison_offer_timing'] == 'after the weekend'

decisive_facts.why: Inez's proposal changes the accepted parker to Inez, the fee to exactly $125, the access window to Tuesday-Friday 06:00-18:00, and payment timing to in advance.
Gareth's information changes the comparison record to exactly $150 for Friday-Sunday overnight use with payment after the weekend.
Maya's Saturday setup changes the arrangement from unrestricted Saturday use to a required Saturday 07:00-10:00 driveway clearance.
Jon's measurement changes the parking terms to nose-in parking with exactly 0.50 metres of side-gate clearance and supplies the fact Elena must cite for those terms.
